questions.q: What is the primary focus of System Integration Testing (SIT)?
options: Testing one screen in isolation
Validating an end-to-end business process across modules and system boundaries
Writing the original requirements document
Approving the project charter
questions.explain: SIT validates a full, integrated business process across modules (and connected systems), not an isolated screen or function.

options: Business users and super users
Only the Executive Sponsor
The project team: functional and technical consultants, coordinated by a testing lead
Oracle Support engineers
questions.explain: SIT is run by the project team itself as a quality gate before business users are asked to spend time testing.

questions.q: What typically must be true before SIT can begin, according to its entry criteria?
options: The Executive Sponsor must resign
The legacy system must be fully decommissioned
Hypercare must already be underway
Configuration must be complete and promoted to Test, with test data loaded and scripts traced to the RTM
questions.explain: SIT entry criteria typically require configuration promoted to the Test environment, test data loaded, and test scripts written and traced to the RTM.

questions.q: What must typically happen before SIT can be declared complete (its exit criteria)?
options: All critical/high-priority scripts pass and open defects are triaged to an acceptable severity
The Executive Sponsor approves the final invoice
Hypercare support staffing is confirmed
The quarterly update calendar is published
questions.explain: SIT exit criteria typically require critical scripts to pass and open defects to be triaged to an acceptable level before moving into UAT.

questions.q: What did Brightfield's second SIT scenario reveal?
options: That the project charter was never signed
That a partial payment against an invoice did not auto-match in reconciliation
That the legal entity structure was wrong
That the Treasury Manager was unavailable
questions.explain: Brightfield's SIT cycle found that a partial payment scenario failed to auto-match, which became a logged defect before SIT could close for Cash Management.
